title: Modify the Matrix
summary: Given an m x n integer matrix, generate a new matrix identical to the original.
statement: Given an m x n integer matrix, generate a new matrix identical to the original. Replace each -1 with the maximum value from its column. Return the modified matrix.
constraints: For every -1 cell, replace it with the greatest original value in the same column.
Return a modified copy of the rectangular matrix.
hints: Compute replacements one column at a time from the original matrix.
Find the maximum value among all rows in that column.
Write that value only into copied cells equal to -1.
Column-local scanning gives every placeholder exactly its declared maximum while copying protects the caller’s input.
editorial: Column-local scanning gives every placeholder exactly its declared maximum while copying protects the caller’s input.

tests.explanation: Column maxima are seven, eight, and nine, producing [[1,2,9],[4,8,6],[7,8,9]].
The replacements use column maxima three and two, producing [[3,2],[3,2]].
